import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    n = int(data[1])

    k = 0
    if w > 2:
        for i in range(21):
            k = i
            if w ** i > 1e9:
                break

    s = set()
    if w > 2:
        pows = [w ** i for i in range(k + 1)]
        s.add(0)
        for p in pows:
            added = [x + p for x in s]
            s.update(added)

    bol = (w == 2)
    for i in s:
        if i >= n and (i - n) in s:
            bol = True
            break

    print("YES" if bol else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
